title: Terms of Use (ToS) and Privacy Policy

purpose.subtitle: 1. Purpose
purpose.line1: These terms define the use of the website playsnapcard.com and the rights and obligations of users regarding their personal data.

dataController.subtitle: 2. Data Controller
dataController.line1: The data controller is: Sokolowski Nicolas

hosting.subtitle: 3. Hosting
hosting.line1: The website is hosted by: OVH
hosting.line2: Data is exclusively stored in Germany.

data.subtitle: 4. Data Collected
data.line2: Email address upon registration, for the newsletter or via the contact form.
data.line3: Functional cookies (access token and refresh token) to secure access and manage your account.
data.line4: LocalStorage: only your email address, to maintain the session and facilitate access to your account.

purposeEmailAndData.subtitle: 5. Purpose of Emails and Data
purposeEmailAndData.line2: Modification of your rights on the website
purposeEmailAndData.line3: Important alerts related to your account
purposeEmailAndData.line4: → These emails are necessary for the operation of the service and do not require additional consent.
purposeEmailAndData.line6: To receive the newsletter or commercial information, your explicit consent is required via a checkbox upon registration.
purposeEmailAndData.line7: You may unsubscribe at any time through a link in each email.
purposeEmailAndData.line8: Cookies: used only for authentication and account security.
purposeEmailAndData.line9: LocalStorage: temporarily stores your email to maintain the session and facilitate account access.
purposeEmailAndData.line10: → These data are necessary for the operation of the service and do not require additional consent.
purposeEmailAndData.line11: Email delivery: Emails are sent via Google’s SMTP service (Gmail).
purposeEmailAndData.line12: No personal data is shared with third parties, except where required by law.

cookies.subtitle: 6. Cookies
cookies.line1: We use two cookies strictly necessary for the operation of the service:
cookies.line2: Access cookie (access token): secures your session and verifies your identity.
cookies.line3: Refresh cookie (refresh token): keeps you logged in without frequent reauthentication.
cookies.line4: These cookies do not contain sensitive data (such as passwords) but only technical identifiers necessary for security.
cookies.line8: As these cookies are essential for the operation of the site, they do not require prior consent.

dataRetention.subtitle: 7. Data Retention
dataRetention.line1: Functional emails: stored for as long as necessary to manage your account or requests.
dataRetention.line2: Newsletter: stored while you are subscribed and until you unsubscribe.
dataRetention.line3: LocalStorage: stored as long as the session is active or until deleted by the user.

userRights.subtitle: 8. User Rights
userRights.line5: Delete your account and your data
userRights.line6: Request portability of your data: export of your email address
userRights.line7: Object to or restrict processing: only applicable for marketing emails
userRights.line8: These actions can be carried out via the features available in your account.
userRights.line9: If you delete your account, all your personal data will be immediately removed from our systems, except for any data we may need to retain to comply with legal obligations (e.g., billing or security).
userRights.line10: If you encounter a problem or prefer manual processing, please contact us at: contact@playsnapcard.com

minors.subtitle: 9. Use by Minors
minors.line1: The website is intended for users aged 15 and over.
minors.line2: Users under the age of 15 must obtain the authorization of their legal representative or use the service within an educational setting, under the responsibility of their institution.

security.subtitle: 10. Security
security.line1: Secure cookies and LocalStorage for authentication
security.line2: Data access limited to authorized personnel
security.line4: Sensitive data (passwords) are never stored in plain text, neither on the client side nor on the server side

legalBasis.subtitle: 11. Legal Basis
legalBasis.line1: The processing of your data is based on:
legalBasis.line2: Your consent (e.g., subscription to the newsletter)
legalBasis.line3: Or the performance of a contract and legitimate interest (account management, secure authentication, operation of the site)

policyUpdates.subtitle: 12. Policy Updates
policyUpdates.line1: This policy may be modified at any time.
policyUpdates.line2: In the event of a substantial change, users will be notified by email or via a notification on the site.

contact.subtitle: 13. Contact
contact.line1: For any questions regarding your personal data or the application of these Terms of Use, please contact us at: contact@playsnapcard.com
